ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% low-intensity (dark) to 40% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity (white) mottle covering the medial-to-distal section of the left lobe; concentrated white patch at the distal tip of the right lobe; central notch and leading edges are characterized by low-intensity (black) pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Dense, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 2 to 6 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering into sharp, upward-turned distal tips; trailing edges follow a broad convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-intensity clusters (3-10 pixels in diameter) scattered across the dark-pigmented medial regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, horizontally-oriented linear pixel disruptions visible on the dark field of the left lobe's mid-section.
